description: Can you afford the next call? Give a planned `cost`; returns {needed, have, shortfall, tool_to_call_next}. Free. Agent keys read their own wallet; a JoulePAI or ENYAL credential may pass `wallet_id`.

cost.description: The joules the next call will cost (its joules_all_in from billing_quote).

wallet_id.description: Wallet to read (UUID); omit to use your own. Not used with a GreenlandAI agent key.

name: joules_deficit
